newsitem.title: UK: Jarvis plans two purchases for 55 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Jarvis plans two purchases for 55 mln stg.

text.p: British building and construction group Jarvis Plc said on Thursday it planned to acquire Fastline Group Ltd and the remaining 50 percent it did not own in Relayfast Ltd, two UK track renewal companies for 55 million stg.
Out of the total price, between 2.7 million and 8.3 million stg will be paid through Jarvis shares, while the balance will be in cash.
Fastline is based in York and currently operates primarily in the north and east of England. Relayfast is based in Glasgow and operates primarily in Scotland and the west of England.
Both acquisitions are dependent on the approval of the Office of Fair Trading.
Fastline employs about 1,200 people while Relayfast has 740 employees.
